hero.title: Delete your Mad Miners account
hero.subtitle: You can ask us to delete your account and all of its game data at any time.

steps.title: Email us
steps.text: Send an email to {email} with the subject "Delete my account".

steps.title: Tell us which account
steps.text: Include your in-game username. If you linked Google, send the email from that Google address so we can confirm it's you.

steps.title: We confirm and delete
steps.text: We may reply to confirm the request, then delete the account within 30 days and email you when it's done.

deleted.title: What gets deleted
items: Your account, username and sign-in methods (guest and Google).
All sessions (you'll be signed out everywhere).
Statistics, coins, gems, wallet history, Locker items and daily reward progress.
Your entries in match history and on the leaderboards.

kept.title: What may be kept
items: Results of past matches other players took part in may still show your username as the winner, without any link to your account.
Information we must keep by law, only for as long as the law requires.

deviceNote: Uninstalling the app clears the data stored on your phone (settings and sign-in), but it does not delete your account on our servers. Use the steps above for that.
